title: Code and data for: Ridge-to-reef sediment management under uncertainty: a Bayesian belief network approach
description: Results workbook, figure and table code (Python and R), figures and Supplementary Information for Oleson et al., 'Ridge-to-reef sediment management under uncertainty: a Bayesian belief network approach' (submitted to Marine Pollution Bulletin). The code regenerates Figures 6, 7 and S1-S3, the Table 2 cost-effectiveness values and the graphical abstract from data/Results-scenario-landowner-subwatershed.xlsx. See README.md.
